overview: Guessing hashtags wastes posts. We research what people in your market search for and follow, across social search, hashtags and caption words. We group them by topic and buying stage, mark which are broad, medium and niche, and flag any that are banned, spammy or off-topic. You receive a tidy sheet you can paste from, with notes on where each set fits best.

faq: They help platforms understand your topic, but they are less powerful than a few years ago. We favour a small, relevant set and strong keywords in captions and profile text over long tag lists.
Can you research for a local business?
Yes. We include location tags, local search phrases and neighborhood terms so people nearby can find you. Tell us your service area in the order form.
Do the keywords help my website SEO too?
Some will overlap, and we point those out. For full website search work, our SEO services go much deeper, and this service stays focused on social platforms.
How do I use the sheet?
Each group is labeled with when to use it. Copy a set into your caption or first comment, and rotate groups across posts, as the sheet explains.
